local function draggable(frame,handle)  
	local dragging = false  
	local dragStart  
	local startPos  
  
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)  
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then  
  
			dragging = true  
			dragStart = input.Position  
			startPos = frame.Position  
  
			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y  
			)  
		end  
	end)  
end

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Coin Farm, Auto Ski and Auto Quest + More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for a Roblox ski game uses FishyUI and opens with RightAlt, attaching to the game's own live client modules so it drives the same ski state and run flow the game steps every frame. Auto coin farm routes the body coin to coin while keeping the run alive, with two movement modes: teleport, which writes CFrame straight onto each coin (no collision sweep, so nothing to hit on the way), and glide, which steps under the game's broad-phase band so the swept grab segment picks up whatever lies between coins. It reopens runs when they drop, clicks the game's own continue prompt after a wreck to skip the twenty-second timeout, and cycles the run once the server's per-run payout cap is reached. Quest handling ranks all roughly forty rotation quests, holds the six the farm can actually finish (coin, score, airtime, maxair, survive), swaps out ones it can't drive, and asks for finished ones — while skipping kinds like trick, ring and wallride that need input the farm never makes, and distance quests the server won't credit for a teleport. Live panels show ski state, credited coins, picked up, coins per minute, run count, quests held, quests completed, and XP, alongside a log of key events. Anti-AFK keeps the client from idling out, and a settings tab documents the game's own numbers — grab radius, stuck watchdog, run cap, and quest slots — plus whether live tables were verified. Theme and config saving work through FishyUI's addons but degrade gracefully if either is missing.

SKI, SKI ALPHA

scripts.script:
pcall(function()

	local set = setthreadidentity or set_thread_identity or setthreadcontext or set_identity

	if set then pcall(set, 8) pcall(set, 7) end

end)

local RGB = Color3.fromRGB

local CREDIT_LINK = "https://discord.gg/7Pfw9GWnub"
local CREDIT_TEXT = "Open sourced and removed key system by " .. CREDIT_LINK

local function copyLink()
	local ok = false
	pcall(function() if type(setclipboard) == "function" then setclipboard(CREDIT_LINK) ok = true end end)
	pcall(function()
		local s = game:GetService("StarterGui")
		if s and s.SetClipboard then s:SetClipboard(CREDIT_LINK) ok = true end
	end)
	return ok
end

local function creditWait()
	local player = game:GetService("Players")
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")

	local host
	pcall(function() if type(gethui) == "function" then host = gethui() end end)
	if type(host) ~= "Instance" then host = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") end
	if not host then host = player.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

	local done = false

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "LiquidHubCredit" gui.DisplayOrder = 999999 gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false gui.Parent = host

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Name = "Backdrop" bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) bg.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(3, 5, 10)
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 bg.BorderSizePixel = 0 bg.Active = true bg.Parent = gui

	local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
	card.Name = "Card" card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) card.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 240) card.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(10, 14, 22)
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0 card.AutoButtonColor = false card.Text = "" card.TextTransparency = 1
	card.Active = true card.Parent = bg

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) corner.Parent = card
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") stroke.Color = RGB(28, 42, 62) stroke.Thickness = 1 stroke.Parent = card

	local function label(str, ypos, h, sz, col, align)
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, h) l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, ypos)
		l.BackgroundTransparency = 1 l.Font = Enum.Font.Code l.TextSize = sz
		l.Text = str l.TextColor3 = col l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		l.Active = false l.Parent = card
		return l
	end

	label("LIQUID HUB", 20, 14, 11, RGB(88, 102, 122))
	label("OPEN SOURCE", 20, 14, 11, RGB(18, 168, 255), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 1) rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44)
	rule.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(28, 42, 62) rule.BorderSizePixel = 0 rule.Parent = card

	label("Key system removed", 60, 30, 24, RGB(226, 236, 246))
	local sub = label(CREDIT_TEXT, 96, 58, 13, RGB(122, 138, 160))
	sub.TextWrapped = true sub.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "Copy" btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 40) btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 162)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = RGB(18, 168, 255) btn.BorderSizePixel = 0 btn.AutoButtonColor = false
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code btn.TextSize = 14 btn.Text = "copy link" btn.TextColor3 = RGB(4, 11, 24)
	btn.Active = true btn.Parent = card
	local bc = Instance.new("UICorner") bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) bc.Parent = btn

	label("or press enter", 208, 14, 11, RGB(70, 82, 100), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

	local function paint(target, col)
		tween:Create(target, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = col}):Play()
	end

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() paint(btn, RGB(64, 198, 255)) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() paint(btn, RGB(18, 168, 255)) end)
	card.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = RGB(54, 100, 146)}):Play() end)
	card.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = RGB(28, 42, 62)}):Play() end)

	local conn
	local function accept()
		if done then return end
		if not copyLink() then
			btn.Text = "copy failed - press enter to retry"
			paint(btn, RGB(196, 58, 78))
			return
		end
		done = true
		btn.Text = "copied - loading"
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
	end

	conn = uis.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, focused)
		if done or focused then return end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then accept() end
	end)

	card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(accept)
	card.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then accept() end
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(accept)

	while not done do task.wait(0.1) end

	local fade = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	tween:Create(bg, fade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	tween:Create(card, fade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	tween:Create(stroke, fade, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
	for _, d in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			tween:Create(d, fade, {TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
			tween:Create(d, fade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.45)
	pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
end

	table.sort(names)
	return names
end

local function abbreviate(value)
	value = tonumber(value) or 0
	local units = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
	local index = 1
	while value >= 1000 and index < #units do
		value /= 1000
		index += 1
	end
	if index == 1 then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
	return string.format("%.2f%s", value, units[index])
end

local function formatClock(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(math.floor(seconds), 0)
	local hours   = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
	local minutes = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
	local secs    = seconds % 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, secs)
end

local function packSet(sel)
	if type(sel) ~= "table" then return "" end
	local names = {}
	for k, v in pairs(sel) do
		if type(k) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = k end
		if type(v) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = v end
	end
	table.sort(names)
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

local function unpackSet(str)
	local set = {}
	if type(str) == "string" and str ~= "" then
		for name in string.gmatch(str, "[^,]+") do
			set[name] = true
		end
	end
	return set
end

local function asList(packed)
	local list = {}
	if type(packed) == "string" and packed ~= "" then
		for name in string.gmatch(packed, "[^,]+") do
			list[#list + 1] = name
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function getFlag(n) return ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("LH_" .. n) end
local function setFlag(n, v) ReplicatedStorage:SetAttribute("LH_" .. n, v) end

local function selHas(sel, value)
	if type(sel) ~= "table" then return true end
	local count, hit = 0, false
	for k, v in pairs(sel) do
		count += 1
		if v == true and k == value then hit = true end
		if v == value then hit = true end
	end
	if count == 0 then return true end
	return hit
end

local function seedSet(flagName, list)
	local cur = getFlag(flagName)
	if type(cur) == "string" and cur ~= "" then return end
	local packed = packSet(list)
	if packed ~= "" then setFlag(flagName, packed) end
end

	pcall(function()

		if not char then return end

			if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = not on end
		end
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then hrp.CanCollide = not on end
	end)
end

local function applyHideName(on)
	local char = getCharacter()
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.NameDisplayDistance = on and 0 or 100
			hum.DisplayName = on and "" or LocalPlayer.DisplayName
		end
		for _, gui in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then
				gui.Enabled = not on
				for _, lbl in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
					if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") then
						lbl.Visible = not on
						lbl.TextTransparency = on and 1 or 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function startFly()
	local char = getCharacter()
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	flyOn = true
	setFlag("FlyOn", true)
	pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end)

	flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	flyBG.P = 9e4
	flyBG.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	flyBG.cframe = hrp.CFrame
	flyBG.Parent = hrp

	flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBV.velocity = Vector3.zero
	flyBV.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	flyBV.Parent = hrp

	setNoclip(true)

	flyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not flyOn or not isCurrentGen() then stopFly() return end
		local char2 = getCharacter()
		local hrp2 = char2 and char2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not hrp2 or not flyBV or not flyBG or not cam then return end

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if flyKeys.W then move += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if flyKeys.S then move -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
		if flyKeys.A then move -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if flyKeys.D then move += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
		if flyKeys.Space then move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
		if flyKeys.Ctrl then move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
		if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * flySpeed end

		flyBV.velocity = move
		flyBG.cframe = cam.CFrame
	end)
end

local function zoneReachable(zone)
	local required = ZoneJumpRequirements[zone]
	if required == nil then return true end

	jp = jp and tonumber(jp.Value) or 0

end

local function findEggPrompt(mode)
	local map    = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local stages = map and map:FindFirstChild("Stages")
	if not stages then return nil, nil end

	local root = getRoot()
	local origin = root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
	local zoneFilter   = unpackSet(getFlag("StealZones"))
	local rarityFilter = unpackSet(getFlag("StealRarities"))

	local bestPrompt, bestScore, bestPosition

	for _, stage in ipairs(stages:GetChildren()) do
		local spawned = stage:FindFirstChild("SpawnedEggs")
		if spawned and selHas(zoneFilter, stage.Name) then
			for _, egg in ipairs(spawned:GetChildren()) do
				local rarity = egg:GetAttribute("Rarity")
				if selHas(rarityFilter, rarity) then
					local prompt = egg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
					if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
						local worldPosition = holderPosition(prompt.Parent)
						if worldPosition then
							local distance = (worldPosition - origin).Magnitude
							local rarityIndex = 0
							if Rarities and Rarities.GetIndex then
								rarityIndex = Rarities.GetIndex(rarity) or 0
							end
							local score
							if mode == "Nearest Egg" then
								score = -distance
							else

								if mode == "Best Egg" and not zoneReachable(stage.Name) then continue end
								score = rarityIndex * 1000000 - distance * 0.001
							end
							if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
								bestPrompt, bestScore, bestPosition = prompt, score, worldPosition
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPrompt, bestPosition
end

local function doCarryRecovery()
	if not Toggles.AutoSteal.Value and not Toggles.AutoPlace.Value then
		CarryWatchSince = nil
		return
	end

	local carried = (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0
	local tool = findTool(isEggTool)

	if carried and not tool then
		local base = getPlacementDetector()
		local root = getRoot()
		if base and root and (root.Position - base.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
			teleportTo(base.Position)
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		if not CarryWatchSince then
			CarryWatchSince = os.clock()
		elseif os.clock() - CarryWatchSince > 30 and DropEggRequest then
			DropEggRequest:FireServer()
			CarryWatchSince = os.clock()
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	else
		CarryWatchSince = nil
	end
end

			StopSquattingRequest:FireServer()

local function doAutoPlace()
	if not Toggles.AutoPlace.Value or not PlaceEggRequest then return end
	if os.clock() < NextPlaceAttempt then return end

	local list = {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isEggTool(child) then table.insert(list, child) end
		end
	end)
	if #list == 0 then return end

	PlaceRotation += 1
	local carrying = list[(PlaceRotation % #list) + 1]
	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	local detector = getPlacementDetector()
	if not humanoid or not detector then return end

	NextPlaceAttempt = os.clock() + 2
	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(carrying) end)
	task.wait(0.2)

	PlaceEggRequest:FireServer(carrying:GetAttribute("EggId"), detector.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	task.wait(0.35)

	if not carrying.Parent then
		local delay = tonumber(Options.StealDelay and Options.StealDelay.Value) or 5
		NextStealAt = os.clock() + math.max(delay, 0)
	end
end

local function doAutoSteal()
	if not Toggles.AutoSteal.Value then return end
	if os.clock() < NextStealAt then return end
	if countEggTools() >= 3 then return end
	if (tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CarriedEggCount")) or 0) > 0 then return end

	local prompt, position = findEggPrompt(Options.StealMode and Options.StealMode.Value)
	if not prompt or not position then return end

	if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and StopSquattingRequest then
		StopSquattingRequest:FireServer()
		local deadline = os.clock() + 1.5
		while LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end

	teleportTo(position)
	task.wait(0.35)
	if prompt.Enabled then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
	task.wait(0.4)

	local base = getPlacementDetector()
	if base then
		teleportTo(base.Position)
		task.wait(0.6)
	end
end

	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if mode == "Chosen Pet" then
					if name == chosen and (not bestCps or cps < bestCps) then

					end
				elseif cps <= maxCps and (not bestCps or cps < bestCps) then
					bestTool, bestCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return bestTool
end

local function findMutationPet(targetName)
	local candidate, candidateCps
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				if name == targetName and (not candidateCps or cps < candidateCps) then
					candidate, candidateCps = child, cps
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return candidate
end

local function findDuplicateAnimal()
	local counts, lowest = {}, {}
	forEachContainer(function(container)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if isPetTool(child) then
				local name = child:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or child.Name
				local cps  = tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CashPerSecond")) or math.huge
				counts[name] = (counts[name] or 0) + 1
				if not lowest[name] or cps < lowest[name] then lowest[name] = cps end
			end
		end
	end)

	local bestName, bestCps
	for name, count in pairs(counts) do
		if count >= 2 and (not bestCps or lowest[name] < bestCps) then
			bestName, bestCps = name, lowest[name]
		end
	end
	return bestName
end

	local ready     = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftReady") == true
	local canRemove = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCanRemove") == true
	local detector  = mutationDetector()

	if Toggles.AutoClaimMutation.Value and active and ready then
		fireMutation("MutationPrompt", detector)
		return
	end

	if Toggles.AutoReturnMutation.Value and active and canRemove then
		fireMutation("MutationRemovePrompt", detector)
		return
	end

	if not Toggles.AutoAddMutation.Value or active then return end

	local target = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MutationCraftAnimalName")
	if type(target) ~= "string" or target == "" then
		if Options.MutationMode and Options.MutationMode.Value == "Chosen Animal" then
			target = Options.MutationAnimal and Options.MutationAnimal.Value
		else
			target = findDuplicateAnimal()
		end
	end
	if not target or target == "None" then return end

	local tool = findMutationPet(target)
	if not tool then return end

	local humanoid = getHumanoid()
	if not humanoid then return end

	pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end)
	task.wait(0.2)
	fireMutation("MutationPrompt", detector)
end

local function farmLoop(steps, interval)
	task.spawn(function()
		while isCurrentGen() do
			for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
				if not isCurrentGen() then return end
				local ok, err = pcall(step)
				if not ok and isCurrentGen() then
					warn("[Liquid Hub] " .. tostring(err))
				end
			end
			task.wait(interval or 0.5)
		end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while isCurrentGen() do
		task.wait(300)
		if isCurrentGen() and getFlag("AntiAfkOn") ~= false then
			pcall(function()
				local hum = getHumanoid()
				if hum then hum.Jump = true end
				local virtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
				virtualUser:CaptureController()
				virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
			end)
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while isCurrentGen() do
		pcall(function()
			local uptime    = formatClock(os.clock() - StartedAt)
			local cash      = abbreviate(getCash())
			local level     = tostring(getLevel())
			local carried   = countEggTools()
			local placed    = countPlacedEggs()
			local squatting = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsSquatting") == true

			if StatusGrid and StatusGrid.SetValue then
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Cash", cash)
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Level", level)
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Eggs", string.format("%d / %d", carried, placed))
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Squat", squatting and "training" or "idle",
					squatting and BRAND.Cyan or BRAND.Sheen)
				StatusGrid:SetValue("Uptime", uptime)
			end

			if StatusSession then
				StatusSession.Text = "Uptime: " .. uptime
				StatusCash.Text = "Cash: " .. cash
				StatusLevel.Text = "Level: " .. level
				StatusEggs.Text = string.format("Carried eggs: %d | Placed: %d", carried, placed)
				StatusSquat.Text = "Squatting: " .. tostring(squatting)
			end
		end)
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(95, 50, 255)
    }
}

local function getTheme()
    if currentTheme == "White" then
        return themes.White
    end

    local theme = {}

    for key, value in pairs(themes.Black) do

    if currentTheme == "Custom" then

end

    if currentTheme == "Rainbow" then

local function T(text)
    if language == "EN" then
        return text
    end

    local languageTable = translations[language]

    if languageTable then
        return languageTable[text] or text
    end

    return text
end

local function registerLanguageObject(object, englishText)
    table.insert(languageObjects, {
        Object = object,
        Text = englishText
    })

    object.Text = T(englishText)
end

                    Enum.EasingDirection.Out

                {Scale = 1}

        end
    end

local function setInvisible(state)
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    invisible = state

    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                object.LocalTransparencyModifier = invisible and 1 or 0
            end
        elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
            object.Transparency = invisible and 1 or 0
        end
    end

    setButtonState(
        invisibleButton,
        invisible,
        "Invisible: ON",
        "Invisible: OFF"
    )
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- NOCLIP
--------------------------------------------------

local function enableNoclip()
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if originalCollisions[object] == nil then
                originalCollisions[object] = object.CanCollide
            end

            object.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end

local function disableNoclip()
    for object, state in pairs(originalCollisions) do
        if object and object.Parent then
            object.CanCollide = state
        end
    end

    originalCollisions = {}
end

_G.__EriusApplyInstantPrompt = function(prompt)
    if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        return
    end

    if _G.__EriusPromptDurations[prompt] == nil then
        _G.__EriusPromptDurations[prompt] = prompt.HoldDuration
    end

    if _G.__EriusInstantInteract then
        prompt.HoldDuration = 0
    end
end

_G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts = function()
    for prompt, duration in pairs(_G.__EriusPromptDurations) do
        if prompt and prompt.Parent then
            prompt.HoldDuration = duration
        end
    end
end

_G.__EriusRefreshInstantInteract = function()
    if _G.__EriusInstantInteract then
        for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                _G.__EriusApplyInstantPrompt(object)
            end
        end
    else
        _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts()
    end

    if _G.__EriusSteelInteractButton then
        setButtonState(
            _G.__EriusSteelInteractButton,
            _G.__EriusInstantInteract,
            "Instant Interact: ON",
            "Instant Interact: OFF"
        )
    end
end

connect(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(object)
    if _G.__EriusInstantInteract
        and object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then

        _G.__EriusApplyInstantPrompt(object)
    end
end)

local function getFOVCenter()
    if fovMode == "Crosshair" then
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(size.X / 2, size.Y / 2)
    else
        local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()

        return Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y - inset.Y)
    end
end

local function validTarget(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer
        or targetPlayer == player
        or not targetPlayer.Parent
        or not targetPlayer.Character then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local head = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local _, myRoot = getCharacter()

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not head then
        return false
    end

    if myRoot
        and targetRoot
        and _G.__EriusAimbotRange then

        local distance =
            (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude

        if distance > _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Value then
            return false
        end
    end

    if ignoreNeutral and targetPlayer.Neutral then
        return false
    end

    if ignoreTeam
        and player.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team == player.Team then
        return false
    end

    if ignoreFriends then
        local ok, isFriend = pcall(function()
            return player:IsFriendsWith(targetPlayer.UserId)
        end)

        if ok and isFriend then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function findClosestTarget()
    local center = getFOVCenter()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDistance = fovSize

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if validTarget(targetPlayer) then
            local head = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            if head then
                local screenPos, onScreen =
                    camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)

                if onScreen then
                    local distance =
                        (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude

                    if distance < closestDistance then
                        closestDistance = distance
                        closest = targetPlayer
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, gpe)
    if waitingForClickerKey and clickerOpen then
        if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            clickerKey = input.KeyCode

    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseHeld = true

        if aimbotEnabled then
            currentTarget = findClosestTarget()
        end
    end
end)

local function clearESP(model)
    local data = espObjects[model]

    if data then
        for _, object in pairs(data) do
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        espObjects[model] = nil
    end
end

local function clearAllESP()
    local models = {}

    for model in pairs(espObjects) do
        table.insert(models, model)
    end

    for _, model in ipairs(models) do
        clearESP(model)
    end
end

local function createESP(model)
    if espObjects[model] then
        return
    end

    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not head or not humanoid then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.85
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Adornee = model
    highlight.Parent = gui

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 45)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = gui

    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    text.TextSize = 13
    text.Parent = billboard

    espObjects[model] = {
        Highlight = highlight,
        Billboard = billboard,
        Text = text
    }
end

local function inESPRange(model)
    local _, myRoot = getCharacter()

    if not myRoot then
        return false
    end

    local targetRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not targetRoot then
        return false
    end

    return (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude <= espRange
end

        or not selectedTeleportPlayer.Parent then

    end

    local _, root, humanoid = getCharacter()

_G.__EriusPlaceClickerBesideHub = function()
    local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not cameraNow then
        return
    end

    local viewport = cameraNow.ViewportSize
    local gap = 14

    local hubX = main.AbsolutePosition.X
    local hubY = main.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local hubW = main.AbsoluteSize.X

    local clickerW =
        clickerMinimized
        and 150
        or 320

    local clickerH =
        clickerMinimized
        and 75
        or 375

    local rightX = hubX + hubW + gap
    local leftX = hubX - clickerW - gap

    local targetX

    if rightX + clickerW <= viewport.X - 8 then
        targetX = rightX
    elseif leftX >= 8 then
        targetX = leftX
    else
        if (viewport.X - (hubX + hubW)) >= hubX then
            targetX =
                math.clamp(
                    rightX,
                    8,
                    math.max(8, viewport.X - clickerW - 8)
                )
        else
            targetX =
                math.clamp(
                    leftX,
                    8,
                    math.max(8, viewport.X - clickerW - 8)
                )
        end
    end

    local targetY =
        math.clamp(
            hubY,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - clickerH - 8)
        )

    clickerFrame.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            targetX,
            targetY
        )
end

local function performClickerClick()
    local didClick = false

    pcall(function()
        if type(mouse1click) == "function" then
            mouse1click()
            didClick = true
        elseif type(mouse1press) == "function"
            and type(mouse1release) == "function" then

            mouse1press()
            mouse1release()
            didClick = true
        end
    end)

    if didClick then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        local virtualInput = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

        virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
            pos.X,
            pos.Y,
            0,
            true,
            game,
            0
        )

        virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
            pos.X,
            pos.Y,
            0,
            false,
            game,
            0
        )
    end)
end

local function startClickerDrag(input, source)
    _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront("Clicker")

    clickerDragging = true
    clickerMoved = false
    clickerDragSource = source
    clickerDragStart = input.Position
    clickerStartPosition = clickerFrame.Position
end

local function updateClickerDrag(input)
    if not clickerDragging
        or not clickerDragStart
        or not clickerStartPosition then

        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        -
        clickerDragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then

        clickerMoved = true
    end

    clickerFrame.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            clickerStartPosition.X.Scale,
            clickerStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            clickerStartPosition.Y.Scale,
            clickerStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
end

    end
end)

_G.__EriusPlaceSteelBesideHub = function()
    local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not cameraNow then
        return
    end

    local viewport = cameraNow.ViewportSize
    local gap = 14
    local hubX = main.AbsolutePosition.X
    local hubY = main.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local hubW = main.AbsoluteSize.X

    local steelW =
        _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
        and 150
        or 320

    local steelH =
        _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
        and 75
        or 250

    local rightX = hubX + hubW + gap
    local leftX = hubX - steelW - gap
    local targetX

    if rightX + steelW <= viewport.X - 8 then
        targetX = rightX
    elseif leftX >= 8 then
        targetX = leftX
    else
        targetX =
            math.clamp(
                rightX,
                8,
                math.max(8, viewport.X - steelW - 8)
            )
    end

    local targetY =
        math.clamp(
            hubY + 160,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - steelH - 8)
        )

    _G.__EriusSteelFrame.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(targetX, targetY)
end

_G.__EriusStartSteelDrag = function(input, source)
    if _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront then
        _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront("Steel")
    end

    _G.__EriusSteelDragging = true
    _G.__EriusSteelMoved = false
    _G.__EriusSteelDragSource = source
    _G.__EriusSteelDragStart = input.Position
    _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition = _G.__EriusSteelFrame.Position
end

_G.__EriusUpdateSteelDrag = function(input)
    if not _G.__EriusSteelDragging
        or not _G.__EriusSteelDragStart
        or not _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition then
        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        - _G.__EriusSteelDragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then
        _G.__EriusSteelMoved = true
    end

    _G.__EriusSteelFrame.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition.X.Scale,
            _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition.Y.Scale,
            _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
end

local function setCustomColorFromX(x)
    local startX = colorSlider.AbsolutePosition.X
    local width = colorSlider.AbsoluteSize.X

    if width <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local percent =
        math.clamp(
            (x - startX) / width,
            0,
            1
        )

    customColor =
        Color3.fromHSV(
            percent,
            0.8,
            1
        )

    colorKnob.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            percent,
            0,
            0.5,
            0
        )

    currentTheme = "Custom"
    applyTheme()
end

connect(colorSlider.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType
        == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType
        == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        colorSliding = true
        setCustomColorFromX(input.Position.X)
    end
end)

_G.__EriusCreators.MakeCard = function(xScale, displayName, username)
    local card = Instance.new("Frame")

    card.BackgroundColor3 = getTheme().Panel

    stroke.Color = getAccent()
    stroke.Parent = card

    local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")

    gradient.Parent = card

    local imageHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
    imageHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 185)
    imageHolder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9)
    imageHolder.BackgroundColor3 = getTheme().DarkPanel
    imageHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    imageHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
    imageHolder.Parent = card

    round(imageHolder, 12)

    local imageGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    imageGradient.Rotation = 125
    imageGradient.Parent = imageHolder

    local imageStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    imageStroke.Thickness = 1
    imageStroke.Transparency = 0.45
    imageStroke.Color = getAccent()
    imageStroke.Parent = imageHolder

    local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    avatar.Size = UDim2.new(1.12, 0, 1.12, 0)
    avatar.Position = UDim2.new(-0.06, 0, -0.06, 0)
    avatar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    avatar.Image = ""
    avatar.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    avatar.Parent = imageHolder

    local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 38)
    name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 204)
    name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    name.Text = displayName
    name.TextColor3 = getTheme().Text
    name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    name.TextSize = 24
    name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    name.Parent = card

    local role = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    role.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
    role.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 241)
    role.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    role.Text = T("THE CREATOR")
    role.TextColor3 = getAccent()
    role.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    role.TextSize = 12
    role.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    role.Parent = card

    registerLanguageObject(role, "THE CREATOR")

    local accentLine = Instance.new("Frame")
    accentLine.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    accentLine.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 3)
    accentLine.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -15)
    accentLine.BackgroundColor3 = getAccent()
    accentLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
    accentLine.Parent = card

    round(accentLine, 999)

    local cardScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    cardScale.Scale = 1
    cardScale.Parent = card

    task.spawn(function()
        local okId, userId = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(username)
        end)

        if not okId or not userId then
            return
        end

        local function loadThumbnail(thumbnailType)
            for _ = 1, 8 do
                local okImage, content, isReady = pcall(function()
                    return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
                        userId,
                        thumbnailType,
                        Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420
                    )
                end)

                if okImage and content and content ~= "" and isReady then
                    return content
                end

                task.wait(0.35)
            end

            local okImage, content = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
                    userId,
                    thumbnailType,
                    Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420
                )
            end)

            if okImage and content and content ~= "" then
                return content
            end

            return nil
        end

        local content =
            loadThumbnail(Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarBust)
            or loadThumbnail(Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarThumbnail)

        if content and avatar.Parent then
            avatar.Image = content
        end
    end)

    return {
        Card = card,
        Stroke = stroke,
        Gradient = gradient,
        ImageHolder = imageHolder,
        ImageGradient = imageGradient,
        ImageStroke = imageStroke,
        Avatar = avatar,
        Name = name,
        Role = role,
        AccentLine = accentLine,
        Scale = cardScale
    }
end

        ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, theme.DarkPanel:Lerp(accent, 0.05)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                0.42,
                theme.Main:Lerp(accent, 0.14)
            ),

                theme.DarkPanel:Lerp(accent, 0.08)

task.spawn(function()
    TweenService:Create(
        startupScale,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.22,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {Scale = 1}
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupLogo,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.28,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {ImageTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupTitle,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        {TextTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupDescription,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        {TextTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    local loadingTime = 1.25
    local startTime = tick()

    while running do
        local progress =
            math.clamp(
                (tick() - startTime) / loadingTime,
                0,
                1
            )

        local percent =
            math.floor(
                progress * 100
            )

        startupPercent.Text =
            tostring(percent)
            .. "%"

        startupBar.Size =
            UDim2.fromScale(
                progress,
                1
            )

        if progress >= 1 then
            break
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end

    startupPercent.Text = "100%"
    startupBar.Size =
        UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

    task.wait(0.55)

    TweenService:Create(
        startupFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.In
        ),
        {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1
        }
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupScale,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.In
        ),
        {
            Scale = 1.04
        }
    ):Play()

    for _, object in ipairs(
        startupFrame:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if object:IsA("TextLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    TextTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()

        elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    ImageTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()

        elseif object:IsA("Frame")
            and object ~= startupFrame then

            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()
        end
    end

    task.wait(0.22)

    if startupFrame
        and startupFrame.Parent then

        startupFrame:Destroy()
    end

    startupFinished = true

    tabs.Visible = true
    pages.Visible = true
    credits.Visible = true
    title.Visible = true
    minimize.Visible = true

    if animationsEnabled then
        mainScale.Scale = 0.94

        TweenService:Create(
            mainScale,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.22,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                Scale = hubScale
            }
        ):Play()
    else
        mainScale.Scale = hubScale
    end
end)

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(

            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(

            ) then
                direction +=
                    Vector3.new(
                        0,
                        1,
                        0
                    )
            end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(
                Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift
            ) then
                direction -=
                    Vector3.new(
                        0,
                        1,
                        0
                    )
            end

            if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                direction =
                    direction.Unit

                _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame =
                    root.CFrame

                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                    direction
                    *
                    flySpeed
            else
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                    Vector3.zero

                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
                    Vector3.zero

                if not _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame then
                    _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame =
                        root.CFrame
                end

                root.CFrame =
                    _G.__EriusFlyHoldCFrame
            end

            humanoid:ChangeState(
                Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
            )
        end
    end

    --------------------------------------------------
    -- AIMBOT
    --------------------------------------------------

    local function hasClearShot(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
            return false
        end

        local targetHead = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local myCharacter = player.Character

        if not targetHead or not myCharacter then
            return false
        end

        local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
        local direction = targetHead.Position - origin

        if direction.Magnitude <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {myCharacter}
        params.IgnoreWater = true

        local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

        if not result then
            return true
        end

        return result.Instance
            and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPlayer.Character)
    end

    local function triggerShoot()
        pcall(function()
            if type(mouse1click) == "function" then
                mouse1click()
                return
            end

            if type(mouse1press) == "function"
                and type(mouse1release) == "function" then

                mouse1press()
                task.wait(0.02)
                mouse1release()
                return
            end

            local virtualInput = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

            virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
                pos.X,
                pos.Y,
                0,
                true,
                game,
                0
            )

            task.wait(0.02)

            virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
                pos.X,
                pos.Y,
                0,
                false,
                game,
                0
            )
        end)
    end

    if aimbotEnabled
        and rightMouseHeld then

        if currentTarget
            and validTarget(currentTarget) then

            local head =
                currentTarget.Character:
                FindFirstChild("Head")

            if head then
                camera.CFrame =
                    CFrame.new(
                        camera.CFrame.Position,
                        head.Position
                    )

                _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                    camera.CFrame.LookVector

                local _, myRoot, myHumanoid =
                    getCharacter()

                if myRoot and myHumanoid then
                    if _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate == nil then
                        _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate =
                            myHumanoid.AutoRotate
                    end

                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate = false

                    -- Lock the character's yaw to the same direction
                    -- the aimbot/camera is currently aiming.
                    local cameraLook =
                        camera.CFrame.LookVector

                    local flatLook =
                        Vector3.new(
                            cameraLook.X,
                            0,
                            cameraLook.Z
                        )

                    if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        myRoot.CFrame =
                            CFrame.lookAt(
                                myRoot.Position,
                                myRoot.Position
                                    + flatLook.Unit
                            )

                        _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                            cameraLook
                    end
                end
            end

        elseif targetSwitching then
            currentTarget =
                findClosestTarget()
        end
    end

    if triggerAimEnabled
        and aimbotEnabled
        and rightMouseHeld
        and currentTarget
        and validTarget(currentTarget) then

        if hasClearShot(currentTarget) then
            if triggerAimReadyAt == 0 then
                triggerAimReadyAt = tick() + triggerAimDelay
            elseif tick() >= triggerAimReadyAt then
                triggerShoot()
                triggerAimReadyAt = tick() + triggerAimDelay
            end
        else
            triggerAimReadyAt = 0
        end
    else
        triggerAimReadyAt = 0
    end

    --------------------------------------------------

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(

    ) do

            local char =

                    data.Billboard.Enabled =

                end

connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function(dt)
        if not running then
            return
        end

        if clickerOpen
            and clickerEnabled then

            clickerAccumulator =
                clickerAccumulator
                +
                dt

            local interval =
                1
                /
                math.max(
                    clickerCPS,
                    1
                )

            local clicksThisFrame =
                0

            while clickerAccumulator
                >= interval
                and clicksThisFrame < 50 do

                clickerAccumulator =
                    clickerAccumulator
                    -
                    interval

                performClickerClick()

                clicksThisFrame =
                    clicksThisFrame
                    +
                    1
            end
        else
            clickerAccumulator =
                0
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputEnded,
    function(input)
        if clickerOpen
            and clickerKey
            and _G.__EriusClickerMode == "Hold"
            and input.KeyCode == clickerKey then

            _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = false
            clickerEnabled = false
            clickerAccumulator = 0
            refreshClickerVisual()
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then

            rightMouseHeld = false

            local _, myRoot, myHumanoid =
                getCharacter()

            if _G.__EriusAimLastLook then
                local releaseLook =
                    _G.__EriusAimLastLook

                if myRoot then
                    local characterLook =
                        myRoot.CFrame.LookVector

                    local horizontal =
                        Vector3.new(
                            characterLook.X,
                            0,
                            characterLook.Z
                        )

                    if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        local vertical =
                            math.clamp(
                                releaseLook.Y,
                                -0.98,
                                0.98
                            )

                        local horizontalScale =
                            math.sqrt(
                                math.max(
                                    0.001,
                                    1 - vertical * vertical
                                )
                            )

                        releaseLook =
                            Vector3.new(
                                horizontal.Unit.X * horizontalScale,
                                vertical,
                                horizontal.Unit.Z * horizontalScale
                            ).Unit
                    end
                end

                camera.CFrame =
                    CFrame.lookAt(
                        camera.CFrame.Position,
                        camera.CFrame.Position
                            + releaseLook
                    )

                _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                    releaseLook
            end

            if myHumanoid then
                if _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate ~= nil then
                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate =
                        _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate
                else
                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end
            end

            _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate = nil
            currentTarget = nil
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            slidingRange = false

            if _G.__EriusAimbotRange then
                _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Sliding = false
            end

            colorSliding = false

            if clickerDragging then
                local source =
                    clickerDragSource

                local wasMoved =
                    clickerMoved

                clickerDragging = false
                clickerDragSource = nil
                clickerDragStart = nil
                clickerStartPosition = nil

                if source == "minimize"
                    and not wasMoved then

                    setClickerMinimized(
                        not clickerMinimized
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
)

    UIS.InputChanged,
    function(input)
        if slidingRange then
            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                setRangeFromMouse(
                    input.Position.X
                )
            end
        end

        if _G.__EriusAimbotRange
            and _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Sliding then

            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                _G.__EriusAimbotRange.SetFromX(
                    input.Position.X
                )
            end
        end

        if colorSliding then
            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                setCustomColorFromX(
                    input.Position.X
                )
            end
        end

        if clickerDragging then
            if input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                updateClickerDrag(input)
            end
        end
    end
)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLEANUP / LEAVE SCRIPT
--------------------------------------------------

local function cleanup()
    if not running then
        return
    end

    running = false
    flying = false
    noclip = false
    aimbotEnabled = false
    _G.__EriusInfiniteJump = false
    _G.__EriusInstantInteract = false

    if _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts then
        _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts()
    end

    triggerAimEnabled = false
    triggerAimReadyAt = 0

    clickerEnabled = false
    clickerOpen = false
    _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = false
    clickerKey = nil
    waitingForClickerKey = false
    clickerAccumulator = 0

    rightMouseHeld = false
    currentTarget = nil

    local _, root, humanoid =
        getCharacter()

    if root then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
            Vector3.zero
    end

    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed =
            normalSpeed
    end

    disableNoclip()

    if invisible then
        invisible = false

        local character =
            player.Character

        if character then
            for _, object in ipairs(
                character:GetDescendants()
            ) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.LocalTransparencyModifier =
                        0
                elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
                    object.Transparency =
                        0
                end
            end
        end
    end

    clearAllESP()

    if blur then
        blur:Destroy()
    end

    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle:Destroy()
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(
        connections
    ) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    table.clear(connections)

    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DRAG
--------------------------------------------------

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition
local moved = false
local dragSource

local function startDrag(input, source)
    _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront("Hub")

    dragging = true
    moved = false
    dragSource = source
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPosition = main.Position
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not dragging then
        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        -
        dragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then

        moved = true
    end

    main.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
end

connect(
    minimize.InputBegan,
    function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            startDrag(
                input,
                "minimize"
            )
        end
    end
)

connect(
    title.InputBegan,
    function(input)
        if minimized then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            startDrag(
                input,
                "title"
            )
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputChanged,
    function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            updateDrag(input)

            if _G.__EriusSteelDragging
                and _G.__EriusUpdateSteelDrag then

                _G.__EriusUpdateSteelDrag(input)
            end
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputEnded,
    function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            if _G.__EriusSteelDragging then
                local steelSource =
                    _G.__EriusSteelDragSource

                local steelMoved =
                    _G.__EriusSteelMoved

                _G.__EriusSteelDragging = false
                _G.__EriusSteelDragSource = nil
                _G.__EriusSteelDragStart = nil
                _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition = nil

                if steelSource == "minimize"
                    and not steelMoved
                    and _G.__EriusSetSteelMinimized then

                    _G.__EriusSetSteelMinimized(
                        not _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
                    )
                end
            end

            if dragging then
                local source =
                    dragSource

                local wasMoved =
                    moved

                dragging = false
                dragSource = nil
                dragStart = nil
                startPosition = nil

                if source
                    == "minimize"
                    and not wasMoved then

                    setMinimized(
                        not minimized
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
)

scripts.script:
--[[
    Animation Control Center
    LocalScript
    Place in: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

    Features:
    • Disable non-walking animations
    • Walking/running animations remain enabled
    • Draggable GUI
    • Minimize / close
    • Control / Settings / Appearance / Hotkeys / About tabs
    • Multiple themes
    • UI scaling
    • Custom GUI hotkey
    • Notifications
    • Auto-disable non-walking animations on respawn
    • Stop current non-walking animations
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local Settings = {
	NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false,
	Theme = "Dark",
	UIScale = 1,
	Keybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	Notifications = true,
	AutoDisableOnSpawn = false,
}

--==================================================
-- THEMES
--==================================================

local Themes = {
	Dark = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 23),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 32),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(31, 31, 40),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 70),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(230, 75, 75),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 120),
	},

	Blue = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 22, 38),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(18, 32, 52),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(25, 43, 68),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 175, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(150, 180, 210),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 75, 110),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 130),
	},

	Purple = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(25, 15, 35),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(37, 22, 52),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(48, 29, 66),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(155, 85, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 125, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(180, 160, 200),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(75, 50, 95),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 100),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(75, 210, 135),
	},

	Green = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 28, 22),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(18, 42, 32),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(25, 55, 42),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 120),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 155),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 245),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(155, 195, 175),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 85, 65),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 130),
	},
}

local CurrentTheme = Themes[Settings.Theme]

--==================================================
-- HELPERS
--==================================================

local function tween(object, properties, duration)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		duration or 0.2,
		Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	)

	TweenService:Create(object, info, properties):Play()
end

local function round(object, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)
	corner.Parent = object
	return corner
end

local function addStroke(object, color, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = 0.3
	s.Parent = object
	return s
end

local function create(className, properties, parent)
	local object = Instance.new(className)

	for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
		object[property] = value
	end

	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--==================================================

local animationConnection
local characterConnection

local function getCharacter()
	return player.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()
	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return nil
	end

	return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getAnimator()
	local humanoid = getHumanoid()

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	return humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
end

--==================================================
-- WALK/RUN DETECTION
--==================================================

local function animationObjectMatchesTrack(animationObject, track)
	if not animationObject:IsA("Animation") then
		return false
	end

	if not track.Animation then
		return false
	end

	if animationObject.AnimationId == "" then
		return false
	end

	return animationObject.AnimationId == track.Animation.AnimationId
end

local function isDefaultMovementAnimation(track)
	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

	if not animate then
		return false
	end

	-- Roblox default walking animations
	local walkFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("walk")

	if walkFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(walkFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- Roblox default running animations
	local runFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("run")

	if runFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(runFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function isWalkingAnimation(track)
	local name = string.lower(track.Name or "")

	-- Common names used by custom animation systems.
	if string.find(name, "walk", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	if string.find(name, "run", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	-- Check Roblox's Animate script.
	if isDefaultMovementAnimation(track) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL
--==================================================

local function stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then
		return
	end

	for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		if not isWalkingAnimation(track) then
			pcall(function()
				track:Stop(0)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function disconnectAnimationListener()
	if animationConnection then
		animationConnection:Disconnect()
		animationConnection = nil
	end
end

local function connectAnimationListener()
	disconnectAnimationListener()

	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then
		return
	end

	animationConnection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		if not Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
			return
		end

		if isWalkingAnimation(track) then
			return
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
				pcall(function()
					track:Stop(0)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function disableNonWalkingAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = true

	stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	connectAnimationListener()
end

local function enableAllAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false

	disconnectAnimationListener()
end

local function toggleNonWalkingAnimations()
	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		enableAllAnimations()
	else
		disableNonWalkingAnimations()
	end
end

-- GUI
--==================================================

local title = create("TextLabel", {

	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,

	TextSize = 18,

}, topBar)

local subtitle = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 18),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(21, 32),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Walking animations stay active",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, topBar)

local minimizeButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 10),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
	Text = "−",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,

round(minimizeButton, 8)

local closeButton = create("TextButton", {

round(closeButton, 8)

--==================================================
-- SIDEBAR
--==================================================

local sidebar = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Sidebar",
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 1, -58),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,

}, main)

create("UIPadding", {
	PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 15),
	PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
	PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
}, sidebar)

create("UIListLayout", {
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
}, sidebar)

--==================================================
-- CONTENT
--==================================================

local content = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Content",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, -58),

	BorderSizePixel = 0,

--==================================================
-- NOTIFICATIONS
--==================================================

local notificationHolder = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Notifications",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 400),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -330, 0, 15),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,

create("UIListLayout", {
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
}, notificationHolder)

local function notify(message, color)
	if not Settings.Notifications then
		return
	end

	local notification = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 55),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, notificationHolder)

	round(notification, 10)
	addStroke(notification, color or CurrentTheme.Accent, 1)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = message,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, notification)

	notification.Position = UDim2.new(1, 30, 0, 0)

	tween(notification, {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}, 0.25)

	task.delay(2.5, function()
		if notification.Parent then
			tween(notification, {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 30, 0, 0)
			}, 0.25)

			task.wait(0.3)

			if notification.Parent then
				notification:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- TABS
--==================================================

local tabs = {}
local pages = {}

local function createTab(name, icon)
	local button = create("TextButton", {

		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),

--==================================================
-- UI COMPONENTS
--==================================================

local function createSectionTitle(parent, text)
	return create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),

local function createCard(parent, height)

local function createToggle(parent, titleText, description, initial, callback)
	local card = createCard(parent, 70)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = titleText,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, card)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 25),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 34),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = description,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 10,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, card)

	local toggle = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -67, 0.5, -14),
		BackgroundColor3 = initial and CurrentTheme.Success or CurrentTheme.Border,
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, card)

	round(toggle, 14)

	local knob = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
		Position = initial
			and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, -11)
			or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -11),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, toggle)

	round(knob, 50)

	local state = initial

	local function setState(value)
		state = value

		tween(toggle, {
			BackgroundColor3 = state
				and CurrentTheme.Success
				or CurrentTheme.Border
		})

		tween(knob, {
			Position = state
				and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, -11)

		})

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		main.Position = UDim2.new(

			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

scripts.features:
This Script can...

- Force Close All Doors: Attempts to close every detected door and gate using its current position or state.

- Force Open All Doors: Attempts to open every detected door and gate.

- Auto-Lock Loop: Repeatedly closes doors that open and calls stopped lifts back to the top floor.

- Auto Sprinklers: Turns sprinklers on once. If someone turns them off afterward, it leaves them off until you restart the toggle.

- 096 / 106 Gate Inversion: Reverses how the script interprets each chamber gate’s open/closed state if its controls behave backward. So if the script keeps repeately opening the 096v or 106 chambers just click this button on the chamber tahts acting up to change teh driection of where this closes. Thsi happens because the script reads it as "I dont know whats close or open so I will use the location of where its at now as close" so if its open in a public server already, the script will read the chamber as close even if its open. Thats why theres an inversion button for the script.

- Spam Gameplay Buttons: Clicks eligible controls independently, choosing a new random 0.25–4 second interval before each click. Includes doors, gates, lift controls, and newly added ClickDetectors.
                 - Spam Exclusions: Skips controls identified as morphs, gamepasses,      purchases, clothing, cosmetics, team selectors, or spawns. Identification uses etector and ancestor names, so unusually named controls may need extra exclusions.

- Print & Copy Door States: Prints a diagnostic report to the F9 console and attempts to copy it to your clipboard. Includes door states, lift positions, and sprinkler details. (THIS IS MAINLY FOR WHEN I WAS CREATING THE SCRIPT. ALTHOUGH YOU CAN USE IT TO IMPROVE THE SCRIPT FOR YOUR OWN)

Panel controls
- Drag the title bar: Moves the panel.
- Drag the bottom-right corner: Resizes the panel.
- Minimize (−): Collapses the panel while active features keep running.
- X or P: Closes the GUI and stops all loops and pending tasks started by this script.
- Automatic cleanup: Also stops the script’s tasks if the GUI is removed, destroyed, hidden, or disabled. Running a new copy shuts down the previous copy first. (might be broken)
Door detection depends on the map’s structure. Single-part doors and chamber gates are assumed to be closed when the script first runs.

NOTE: I was banned from the game but have no idea if it was the script, me flying, or another script I was using which is unrelated. so in any case test the script on an alt account and send in a review to help others :D

-- Remove any previous copy of this script (and stop its loops)
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.FacilityControlStop then pcall(env.FacilityControlStop) end
for _, g in ipairs(game:GetService("CoreGui"):GetChildren()) do
	if g.Name == "FacilityControlV5" or g.Name == "FacilityControl" then g:Destroy() end
end

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Create ScreenGui inside CoreGui to persist across respawns
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FacilityControl"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- GUI settings
local VERSION = "v6.0"
local TITLE_H = 36 -- Height of the title bar (also the height when minimized)
local MIN_W, MAX_W = 230, 520 -- Resize limits (width)
local MIN_H, MAX_H = 180, 700 -- Resize limits (height)

-- State variables
local running = true -- set to false when a newer copy of the script replaces this one
local autoCloseActive = false
local autoSprinklersActive = false
local spamActive = false
local connections = {} -- Event connections to clean up when replaced
local originalPositions = {} -- Closed-position baseline for single-part doors and chamber gates
local lastFired = {} -- Tracks when each door was last clicked (for auto-lock cooldown)
local AUTO_LOCK_COOLDOWN = 2.5 -- Seconds to wait after clicking a door before checking it again
local SPRINKLER_COOLDOWN = 3 -- Seconds to wait after clicking the sprinkler lever
local SPRINKLER_RESUME_AFTER = math.huge -- Seconds before auto sprinklers re-enable after someone turns them off (math.huge = never)
local SPAM_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.25 -- Shortest delay per detector
local SPAM_MAX_INTERVAL = 4 -- Longest delay; randomized after every click
local spamGeneration = 0 -- Invalidates workers on OFF/ON
local spamWorkers = {}
local spamRandom = Random.new()
local LIFT_COOLDOWN = 12 -- Seconds to wait after calling a lift up before checking it again
local CLOSED_TOLERANCE = 0.75 -- Studs of slack when deciding if two door panels are touching
local INVERT_096 = false -- Flips open/closed reading for the 096 gate (toggled by its button)
local INVERT_106 = false -- Flips open/closed reading for the grey box (106) gate (toggled by its button)

local function track(conn)
	table.insert(connections, conn)
	return conn
end

env.FacilityControlStop = function()
	running = false
	autoCloseActive = false
	autoSprinklersActive = false
	spamActive = false
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
end
